content: ANSI SGR layering for side-by-side diff rendering: 3 layers must compose - chroma syntax highlight (foreground colors per token), line-level diff background (full-line background for add/remove/context/modified), intra-line change span highlight (specific character ranges). Key pattern: emit explicit \x1b[0m reset at end of every left-column line before appending the right column. For background color layering over syntax highlight: use termenv SGR sequences directly since lipgloss v2 AdaptiveColor works well for fixed styles but inline spans need manual ANSI construction. For intra-line markers: strip ANSI, run diff on raw text, then re-insert highlight sequences at computed rune positions in the ANSI string (ANSI-aware insert requires tracking ANSI vs visible chars).
